responsibility: This file provides the common bitpack variable-length encoding and decoding primitives used by GCC's streamer infrastructure. It implements compact signed and unsigned half-byte based packing/unpacking for incremental bit streams, forming the shared core that higher-level LTO/data-streamer code uses to serialize fixed-width flags and small values efficiently.
same_name_distinction: Contains the out-of-line implementations of the core variable-length bitpack encoders and decoders (signed and unsigned half-byte packing). The header is broader: it defines the streaming/bitpack API, inline helpers, types, and declarations for the rest of the streamer subsystem.
